scope: Seven inspected development photographs, fourteen frozen prompt/crop attempts, two calibration arms. Some sources overlap CNN training. These are not held-out photos or new independent examples; the established 31-photo benchmark is unchanged.
intervention: Only replace the foreground probability used to sample the RGB palette with the saved SAM body. Preserve full-photo RGB, network material prior, sampling window, supplied selections, frozen crop, coverage, palette algorithm, threshold, and ten-second automatic fitter settings. No crop fitting or outcome-based target tuning.
revision: Explicit v2 preparation reviewed sixteen storage-only benchmark-writer pin changes from 41221c0; all runtime and original input pins stayed unchanged. v1 preserved.

visualReview.reviewed: Original saved source/crop overlays, all nine paired masks and probability maps, all eighteen native weaves and all eighteen editable replays. Color phase differs in some previews; no target phase alignment was used.
findings: Red/green printed checker: conditioning on SAM replaces the blue/green background palette with red/green and restores four main cells, but printed snowflakes and the handle remain false material boundaries. Fresh and editable fits still fail feature/image checks.
Cross: both fits retain a small false central diamond and a thin left-edge artifact despite passing mask and geometry checks. Palette recalibration does not remove these.

Selected star: both retain the six rays, but rounded junctions and small border defects remain. Recalibration reverses color order; 97.03% raw mask change is only 2.97% after a phase swap, not a large design change.
Automatic star-scene box selects the neighboring heart, and remains excluded from intended-object success.

Dense checker: targets remain visibly checker-like. All four fits use eight cuts per sheet and distort/merge cells. This supports investigating count initialization alongside the earlier expanded-count experiment; this palette probe alone does not isolate the count-cap cause or establish crop accuracy.
Gold tree: printed leaves still enter the two-color target and lead to a visibly wrong weave in both arms.
Pale printed checker: both targets and outputs retain the main grid; wavy boundaries and the existing tip/crop uncertainty remain.
Five saved prompt/crop failures per arm are preserved, including painted paper; no new crop search was performed.

importWarnings.details: Legacy raw-JSON validation warned about out-of-range cubic handles (cross left control x=-1.3; wrong-neighbor right control y=-1.1). src/lib/utils/validatePaths.ts tests all control coordinates. Both candidates pass the independent full curve/paper audit and editor intersection checks. The warnings are preserved here; this study does not change that check.

conclusion: The conditioning mismatch explains the printed red/green near-uniform target, but recalibration alone adds no checked intended source. Keep this offline. Printed-ink/material separation, dense count selection, false small features, and remaining crop failures need separate interventions. Never use a low error against an incorrectly extracted target as source-image accuracy.
timingQualification: One serial paired replay with alternating material-arm order and low process priority; timings are not a speed comparison. Each error is measured against its own material target, so error changes across arms are not accuracy improvements against a common ground truth.

resources.execution: Sequential, nice 15, Python numerical pools limited to one. No Chrome or preview server launched.
resources.storagePolicy: No bulky HTML or manufacturability SVG engine diagnostics persisted. Source data and all generated mask/template evidence retained.
